description: Source code for the PDCCH slot resource allocator in a 5G NR scheduler, implementing DFS-based CCE allocation and collision management.

classes.name: pdcch_slot_allocator
classes.description: Class responsible for allocating PDCCH resources using DFS algorithm, managing CCE positions, and handling collisions.

methods.name: alloc_pdcch
methods.description: Attempts to allocate a PDCCH for a given DCI context, retrying with different permutations if necessary.

methods.name: cancel_last_pdcch
methods.description: Cancels the last allocated PDCCH, freeing resources and updating internal state.

methods.name: alloc_dfs_node
methods.description: Creates a DFS tree node for a candidate CCE position if it does not cause collisions.

methods.name: get_next_dfs
methods.description: Generates the next DFS node configuration by backtracking and trying alternative CCE positions.

methods.name: allocate_cce
methods.description: Allocates a specific CCE position if it does not collide with existing allocations.
